name: Big Branch Apiary
tagline: Big Branch Apiary, LLC – Local honey in southeast Louisiana.
description: Big Branch Apiary is a family-run farm in Big Branch, LA. It grows Blueberries, Citrus, and Honey, with seasonal availability through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
